scope: Independent source-backed physical-shape and exported contact-extent review of the exact candidate; no human acceptance or app appearance claim.

resolvedFinding.observation: In the whole actual exported Face A view, both broad relief side transitions now continue beside the mono/duo row. The earlier broad uninterrupted lower strip is reduced accordingly. This matches the qualitative relationship in the whole approved manufacturer Face A photograph.
resolvedFinding.judgment: Resolved for a source-backed display approximation; exact terminal coordinates are not manufacturer measurements.

visualFindings.finding: Face A and whole A/B oblique views show a continuous soft entry into the revised broad surfaces. Face B retains two large deep sloper forms. No newly introduced sharp geometric ridge, reversal, or wavy silhouette is visible. Minor triangulated shading does not establish a physical ripple. Analytic tangent/continuity evidence supports this visual finding.

Each of the four complete faces retains two upper outer slots, two mono pockets, two duo pockets, and one lower central slot: 28 pockets. At both ends the viewed order repeats mono then duo, matching the approved photos. No pocket is visibly displaced or merged into the revised relief.

Prior/current whole C and D views and C/D obliques preserve the shallow C reliefs and substantial rounded D recesses. No new C/D junction change is visible. Actual-export regression records the same 2.7528456839127657 degree seam on both sides, 14 C rays and 8 D rays.

Exact descriptor-owned whole-USDZ overlays on A, B and A/B oblique show each changed B contact covering its own continuous broad relief, including the newly extended Face A portion. Left and right regions remain separate; color does not spill onto the outer/central pockets or unrelated body faces. These are diagnostic ownership views, not app selection/highlight validation.

Inspected whole prior/current front, end-side and top comparisons. Beam envelope and end silhouette are preserved; the change is localized to paired A/B reliefs. The end-side view cannot reveal internal profile shape because the full beam end occludes it, so it is supplemented by whole A/B obliques.

supportingEvidenceReviewed.native: One valid solid at 660 x 100 x 100 mm; 187 fully constrained sketches; 32 unaffected native contact surfaces have zero unmatched common area; meaningful 4% depth edit/restore reported. These are reviewed reports, not independently rerun native operations in this gate.
supportingEvidenceReviewed.export: Root independently reopened actual USDZ and reconstructed descriptor exactly: 35 unbound mesh nodes, 34 contacts, 91612 triangles, envelope within float tolerance, 32 unaffected contact mesh areas/bounds preserved. Candidate bytes independently SHA-256 verified by this reviewer.
supportingEvidenceReviewed.manifest: Only surfaceFinish=wood changes in the full board manifest; contact facts and four positions/rotations preserve. Visible maker-photo grain supports wood without a species claim.

estimatesAndLimits: Endpoint (-50,-20), first tangent pole (-50,-12), curve sections, radii and cavity depths are operator-authored display estimates. No photo pixel measurements were used.
Poker manifest has no per-contact depth fields. Native/export depth numbers are display-geometry guards preserving reference values, not manufacturer-published grip-depth facts.
Approved predominantly face-on photos establish qualitative form and row relationships, not exact manufacturing sections or edge radii.
No cord is documented or introduced. Mounting hardware is intentionally omitted; this does not imply that the physical product lacks it.
CPU/native/export views do not establish runtime wood appearance, app picking/highlighting, workout appearance, or human acceptance.
Second clean export reproducibility is a separate pending author validation at time of this review. This pass binds only to the exact inspected hashes.
